branch_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Suppliers to Create and Submit Product Proposals
branch_001.rationale: The low-level goals collectively describe the complete workflow for a supplier to define all necessary attributes and terms for a product and then submit this information as a formal proposal. Each goal represents a distinct step in the process of preparing and finalizing a product proposal, from initiation to submission for evaluation.
source_low_level_goal_ids: Supplier creates a new product proposal
Supplier adds product category to a proposal
Supplier specifies selling price for a product in a proposal
Supplier sets product availability for a proposal
Supplier uploads product photos for a proposal
Supplier provides a detailed product description for a proposal
Supplier specifies guaranteed delivery time for a product in a proposal
Supplier submits the complete product proposal for review

branch_002.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Supplier to Revise and Resubmit Product Proposals
branch_002.rationale: These low-level goals collectively describe the complete process for a supplier to receive feedback on a submitted product proposal, make necessary edits based on that feedback, and then submit the updated version for re-evaluation. They are all integral steps in managing the revision cycle of proposals.
source_low_level_goal_ids: Supplier retrieves the details and comments for a proposal requiring revisions
Supplier modifies an existing product proposal
Supplier resubmits a revised product proposal

branch_003.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Manage Product Proposal Evaluation and Decision-Making
branch_003.rationale: The low-level goals collectively describe the complete workflow for an administrator to review, assess, and make a final decision on product proposals. This includes retrieving a list, viewing details, and updating the status to accepted, rejected, or requesting revisions with feedback, all of which are integral steps in the evaluation and decision-making process.
source_low_level_goal_ids: Retrieve Pending Product Proposals
View Product Proposal Details
Accept Product Proposal
Reject Product Proposal
Request Revisions for Product Proposal

branch_004.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Facilitate Administrator Oversight of Proposal Deadlines
branch_004.rationale: Both low-level goals contribute to the administrator's ability to effectively monitor and manage the timelines for proposal evaluations. One provides proactive alerts for critical deadlines, while the other offers a comprehensive visual overview of all proposal statuses and deadlines.
source_low_level_goal_ids: Administrator receives reminders for pending product proposals nearing their evaluation deadline
Administrator views a dashboard showing proposals by evaluation status and remaining time

branch_005.rationale: The low-level goals collectively describe the capabilities an administrator needs to configure, activate, deactivate, update, and monitor the system's automatic reorder functionality for products. They all contribute to the overarching objective of controlling and overseeing this automated inventory replenishment process.
source_low_level_goal_ids: Administrator defines a critical reorder threshold for a specific product
Administrator enables automatic reorder for a product
Administrator disables automatic reorder for a product
Administrator modifies an existing reorder rule for a product
Administrator views a list of all configured automatic reorder rules

branch_006.rationale: These low-level goals collectively describe the essential steps involved in the process of receiving products into a system. They cover accessing expected delivery details, recording the actual arrival of items, and verifying that the received items match the order, all of which are critical components of a comprehensive product receiving workflow.
source_low_level_goal_ids: Goods-Receiving Operator retrieves details of an incoming delivery order
Goods-Receiving Operator scans or inputs product identifiers for received items
Goods-Receiving Operator marks a product as verified against the order

branch_007.rationale: The low-level goals collectively describe the process of identifying, documenting, and taking action on problems found during the reception of products. They cover logging issues, providing additional details, and making decisions about the acceptability of delivered items, all of which contribute to effectively managing discrepancies in product deliveries.
source_low_level_goal_ids: Goods-Receiving Operator reports a discrepancy for a delivered product
Goods-Receiving Operator adds notes or photos to a reported discrepancy
Goods-Receiving Operator marks a product as rejected due to a problem

branch_008.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Manage In-Store Product Placement and Location
branch_008.rationale: These low-level goals collectively describe the process of assigning products to specific physical locations within a store. This includes identifying available locations, linking products to those locations upon receipt, and subsequently adjusting the stock levels for products at those designated spots. The overarching intention is to maintain accurate records of where products are physically stored within the retail environment.
source_low_level_goal_ids: Goods-Receiving Operator views available store locations
Goods-Receiving Operator assigns a specific store location to an accepted product
Goods-Receiving Operator updates the inventory count for a product at a specific location

branch_009.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Prepare Received Products for Sale on the Store Floor
branch_009.rationale: These operations collectively describe the essential steps involved in transitioning newly received products from the receiving area to being fully ready and available for purchase by customers on the store floor. They cover identifying products for placement, confirming their physical placement, and ensuring they are correctly priced and labeled.
source_low_level_goal_ids: Store Staff retrieves a list of products ready for placement
Store Staff confirms placement of a product in its designated store location
Store Staff requests printing of price labels for specific products

branch_010.rationale: The low-level goals collectively describe the essential actions performed by the order department staff to complete the administrative and financial closure of a purchase order after products have been delivered and verified. This includes monitoring delivery outcomes, updating the order's status, and authorizing payment, all of which are steps towards finalizing the purchase order.
source_low_level_goal_ids: Order Department Staff retrieves goods reception reports
Order Department Staff updates an order status based on goods reception results
Order Department Staff authorizes payment to a supplier based on verified goods reception

branch_011.rationale: These low-level goals collectively describe the various actions an order department staff member performs to create, review, modify, and cancel purchase orders, whether initiated manually or through automated suggestions. They cover the complete lifecycle of managing product procurement.
source_low_level_goal_ids: Order Department Staff creates a new manual purchase order
Order Department Staff reviews automatically generated reorder proposals
Order Department Staff approves an automatically generated reorder
Order Department Staff modifies an existing purchase order
Order Department Staff cancels a purchase order

branch_012.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Facilitate timely identification and management of low product stock
branch_012.rationale: Both low-level goals contribute to ensuring that the order department staff is promptly informed about products with critically low stock levels. llg_001 provides an automatic alert, while llg_002 offers a continuous monitoring capability, both serving the purpose of enabling timely action to manage and replenish stock.
source_low_level_goal_ids: Order Department Staff receives an alert when a product's inventory falls below its critical reorder threshold
Order Department Staff views a dashboard of products with critical inventory levels

branch_013.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Allow Customer to Select Products for Purchase
branch_013.rationale: The low-level goals collectively describe the complete process a customer follows to identify desired products, gather necessary information about them, and then manage their selection within a virtual shopping cart. This sequence of operations is essential for preparing an order before proceeding to checkout and payment.
source_low_level_goal_ids: Customer searches for products by keyword or category
Customer views product details
Customer adds a product with a specified quantity to their shopping cart
Customer removes a product from their shopping cart
Customer updates the quantity of a product in their shopping cart

branch_014.rationale: The low-level goals collectively describe the necessary functionalities for a customer to successfully complete a payment for a purchase. This includes selecting payment options, securely providing payment information, initiating the payment process in various contexts (online and physical store), and receiving confirmation of a successful transaction. All these operations are integral steps in enabling and facilitating customer payments.
source_low_level_goal_ids: Customer selects a payment method for an online order
Customer submits payment details for an online order
Customer receives confirmation of a successful online purchase
Customer initiates an in-store payment transaction

branch_015.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Provide Comprehensive Order Status Information to Customers
branch_015.rationale: The low-level goals collectively aim to ensure that customers are well-informed about the status and delivery progress of their online orders. llg_001 enables customers to actively query for real-time progress, while llg_002 and llg_003 ensure they receive timely, proactive updates through various communication channels (email and mobile alerts). Together, these operations provide a complete solution for keeping customers informed throughout the order fulfillment process.
source_low_level_goal_ids: Customer retrieves the current delivery status of an online order
Customer receives email notifications for order status changes
Customer receives mobile notifications for order status changes

branch_016.rationale: The low-level goals collectively describe the complete lifecycle of a customer's interaction with a support system. They cover initiating a new request, tracking its status and history, actively participating in ongoing discussions, and receiving timely notifications about updates. All these operations are essential for a customer to effectively manage their support needs and engage with customer service.
source_low_level_goal_ids: Customer creates a new support ticket
Customer views the status and history of their support tickets
Customer adds a reply or comment to an existing support ticket
Customer receives a notification when a support agent replies to their ticket

branch_017.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Effectively Manage Customer Support Ticket Responses
branch_017.rationale: The low-level goals collectively aim to empower agents to provide timely and appropriate responses to customer support tickets. One goal provides the means to compose and send responses, while the other ensures that these responses are delivered within critical service level agreement deadlines, thereby improving overall customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.
source_low_level_goal_ids: Customer-Service Agent sends a reply to a customer support ticket
Customer-Service Agent receives alerts for tickets nearing their response time SLA

branch_018.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Management to Monitor Business Performance and Operations
branch_018.rationale: All low-level goals contribute to providing management with various reports, key performance indicators, and a consolidated dashboard to track and understand the performance of sales, inventory, orders, and customer support, thereby enabling effective oversight of business operations.
source_low_level_goal_ids: Company Management retrieves sales reports for a specified period
Company Management retrieves inventory reports by product or category
Company Management retrieves customer support ticket metrics
Company Management views a dashboard of key business performance indicators

branch_019.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable comprehensive business data analysis for management
branch_019.rationale: Both low-level goals contribute to the overarching objective of providing management with the necessary tools and data to understand business performance, identify trends, and make informed decisions, whether through internal reporting or external analytical tools.
source_low_level_goal_ids: Company Management generates custom analytical reports based on various data sets
Company Management exports business performance data for external analysis tools
